title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
summary: Uses written principles to guide model critique, revision, and AI-generated preferences for training an assistant.
caveat: Choice of principles, the evaluator’s blind spots, and distribution shift still matter; less human labeling is not zero human judgment.
review_scope: Primary-page metadata and abstract checked; findings not independently replicated and full methods not audited.

title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
summary: Measures how optimizing an imperfect reward proxy can eventually reduce performance on a separate reference reward in a synthetic setup.
caveat: The reference reward is itself a model, not direct ground truth about human values.
review_scope: Primary-page metadata and abstract checked; findings not independently replicated and full methods not audited.

title: Goal Misgeneralization: Why Correct Specifications Aren't Enough For Correct Goals
summary: Distinguishes a faulty objective specification from learning the wrong goal despite a correct specification, and demonstrates examples under distribution shift.
caveat: Concrete examples and extrapolated catastrophic scenarios carry different levels of evidence.
review_scope: Primary-page metadata and abstract checked; findings not independently replicated and full methods not audited.

title: Deep reinforcement learning from human preferences
summary: Learns a reward signal from comparisons of short behavior segments and uses it to train reinforcement-learning agents.
caveat: Human preferences are partial and noisy; the original demonstrations are not a complete solution to value alignment.
review_scope: Primary-page metadata and abstract checked; findings not independently replicated and full methods not audited.

title: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
summary: Organizes practical accident-risk research around side effects, reward hacking, expensive supervision, safe exploration, and distribution shift.
caveat: A foundational research agenda, not an exhaustive taxonomy of all present-day AI risks.
review_scope: Primary-page metadata and abstract checked; findings not independently replicated and full methods not audited.
